data.summary: aio-models is a pure Rust data crate that owns the canonical models.json schema, providing schema definition plus read/write and mask/merge/validate operations for model configuration. It is intentionally shared across layers (the sandbox axum `app` server and, later, the `mgr` control plane) so the config schema has exactly one owner. At this directory level only the Cargo.toml manifest is present, with the actual implementation living in the child source subdirectory.

file_insights.summary: Cargo manifest defining the `aio-models` crate, a pure data/serde crate holding the canonical model-config schema. It declares no HTTP/axum dependencies, keeping the crate limited to IO + serde responsibilities.
file_insights.source_summary: Cargo package metadata for `aio-models` version 0.1.0, edition 2021. The description and comments document it as a pure data crate providing the canonical models.json schema with read/write, mask, merge and validation logic, with no axum/http dependency and file IO done through an injectable &Path plus JSON serialization.
file_insights.detailed_description: This manifest declares the `aio-models` library crate (edition 2021) whose stated purpose is to be the canonical model-config store: schema plus read/write plus mask/merge/validate. The inline comments emphasize architectural intent — exactly one owner for the models.json schema, shared between the `app` sandbox server and the future `mgr` control plane. It deliberately avoids axum/http dependencies, since routing lives in `app` and this crate is IO + serde only with file access via an injectable &Path.
responsibilities: Declare the `aio-models` library package identity and version
Establish the crate as the single owner of the models.json schema
Enforce a dependency boundary (IO + serde only, no axum/http)
Declare manifest metadata and dependencies used for schema read/write/serde
